name: react-nestjs-microservices-demo
description: React + NestJS 微服务学习 Demo

scripts.build:services: npm run build -w @demo/shared && npm run build -w @demo/users-service && npm run build -w @demo/orders-service && npm run build -w @demo/gateway
scripts.start:services: concurrently -k -n users,orders,gateway -c blue,magenta,green "npm run start:users" "npm run start:orders" "npm run start:gateway"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -n users,orders,gateway,web -c blue,magenta,green,cyan "npm run start:users" "npm run start:orders" "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:web"
